mapper.sql: SUM(pay_amount) AS gmv, SUM(quantity) AS salesQty, COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS orderCnt, COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) AS buyerCnt
mapper.select: SELECT kpi_code, kpi_name, kpi_value, kpi_unit, kpi_desc, stat_date, batch_id FROM ads_overview ORDER BY id

SELECT stat_date AS statDate, COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS orderCnt, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN is_valid_order = 1 THEN order_id END) AS validOrderCnt, SUM(CASE WHEN is_valid_order = 1 THEN pay_amount ELSE 0 END) AS gmv, SUM(CASE WHEN is_valid_order = 1 THEN quantity ELSE 0 END) AS salesQty, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN is_valid_order = 1 THEN user_id END) AS buyerCnt, SUM(CASE WHEN is_valid_order = 1 THEN pay_amount ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN is_valid_order = 1 THEN order_id END), 0) AS avgOrderAmount, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN order_status = '已退款' THEN order_id END) AS refundOrderCnt, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN order_status = '已退款' THEN order_id END) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT order_id), 0) AS refundRate FROM dwd_order_detail WHERE 1 = 1
GROUP BY stat_date ORDER BY stat_date

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN is_valid_order = 1 THEN pay_amount ELSE 0 END) AS gmv, COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS orderCnt, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN is_valid_order = 1 THEN order_id END) AS validOrderCnt, SUM(CASE WHEN is_valid_order = 1 THEN quantity ELSE 0 END) AS salesQty, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN is_valid_order = 1 THEN user_id END) AS buyerCnt, SUM(CASE WHEN is_valid_order = 1 THEN quantity * unit_price ELSE 0 END) AS grossAmount, SUM(CASE WHEN is_valid_order = 1 THEN discount_amount ELSE 0 END) AS discountAmount, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN order_status = '已退款' THEN order_id END) AS refundOrderCnt FROM dwd_order_detail WHERE 1 = 1

SELECT category_name AS name,
FROM dwd_order_detail WHERE 1 = 1
GROUP BY category_name ORDER BY gmv DESC
LIMIT #{q.limit}

SELECT channel AS name,
FROM dwd_order_detail WHERE 1 = 1
GROUP BY channel ORDER BY gmv DESC

SELECT pay_type AS name,
FROM dwd_order_detail WHERE 1 = 1
GROUP BY pay_type ORDER BY gmv DESC

SELECT province AS name,
FROM dwd_order_detail WHERE 1 = 1
GROUP BY province ORDER BY gmv DESC
LIMIT #{q.limit}
SELECT ROUND(SUM(pay_amount), 2) FROM dwd_order_detail WHERE 1 = 1

SELECT channel AS channel, category_name AS categoryName, SUM(pay_amount) AS gmv, COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS orderCnt FROM dwd_order_detail WHERE 1 = 1
GROUP BY channel, category_name ORDER BY channel, gmv DESC
SELECT SUM(gmv) AS gmv, SUM(sales_qty) AS salesQty, SUM(valid_order_cnt) AS validOrderCnt FROM ads_daily_trend

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN is_valid_order = 1 THEN pay_amount ELSE 0 END) AS gmv, SUM(CASE WHEN is_valid_order = 1 THEN quantity ELSE 0 END) AS salesQty, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN is_valid_order = 1 THEN order_id END) AS validOrderCnt FROM dwd_order_detail
SELECT SUM(gmv) FROM ads_category_stat
SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN is_valid_order = 1 THEN pay_amount ELSE 0 END) FROM dwd_order_detail
SELECT DATE_FORMAT(MIN(stat_date), '%Y-%m-%d') AS minDate, DATE_FORMAT(MAX(stat_date), '%Y-%m-%d') AS maxDate FROM ads_daily_trend
SELECT DISTINCT channel FROM ads_channel_stat WHERE channel IS NOT NULL AND channel <> '' ORDER BY channel
SELECT DISTINCT category_name FROM ads_category_stat WHERE category_name IS NOT NULL AND category_name <> '' ORDER BY category_name
SELECT DISTINCT province FROM ads_region_stat WHERE province IS NOT NULL AND province <> '' ORDER BY province
SELECT DISTINCT pay_type FROM ads_paytype_stat WHERE pay_type IS NOT NULL AND pay_type <> '' ORDER BY pay_type
